en: A single bolt of lightning can heat the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the sun's surface.
A single handful of healthy soil contains more living microorganisms than there are people on planet Earth.
Pumice is a unique volcanic rock that naturally floats on water because it is filled with tiny trapped air bubbles.
Diamonds and the graphite in your pencil lead are both made of the exact same pure carbon atoms arranged differently.
If all the water vapor in Earth's atmosphere condensed at once, it would cover the entire planet in just one inch of rain.
Ice cores from Antarctica contain trapped air bubbles that act like time capsules, revealing Earth's exact climate from 800,000 years ago.
Venus is the only planet in our solar system that spins clockwise, meaning the sun rises in the west and sets in the east.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant storm that has been raging for over 300 years and is wider than planet Earth.
A neutron star is so incredibly dense that just one teaspoon of its material would weigh about six billion tons on Earth.
The moon is slowly moving away from Earth at a rate of about 3.8 centimeters per year, roughly the speed your fingernails grow.
Hawaii's Mauna Loa is the largest active volcano on Earth, and if measured from its underwater base, it is taller than Mount Everest.
Underwater earthquakes can trigger massive tsunami waves that travel across the deep ocean at speeds up to 800 kilometers per hour.
